lines.t: (Verse 1)
Feast day, sunrise, fields start shaking
Grain heads bow, dead earth waking
Trumpet in my chest, low bass quaking
Grave-clothes torn, new worlds breaking
Out of the tomb where the night got folded
Stone rolled back, whole timeline molded
He stepped out, glory-coded, golden
Firstfruits King with the keys He’s holding
(Pre-Chorus)
Light-wave, particle, glory in motion
Blood-bought cosmos, sea of devotion
I know who He is, no counterfeit potion
“I AM” written like fire on the ocean
(Chorus)
This that firstfruits gravity, bodies rise rapidly
Harps in the heavenlies, 808s mad at me
YahuShua stomped death, shattered that tragedy
Now we dance heavy in resurrected majesty
(Verse 2)
See that cloth still folded in the chamber
Testimony woven like a coded laser
Shroud left back like, “I’ll see you later”
Witness in the linen to the Rising Savior
Hardcore trap when the sky’s wide open
Galactic glory in the bars I’m quoting
Bass so deep make the strong start choking
Light so clean every chain gets broken
(Bridge – Rap)
Phase through walls, He appears in the middle
Scars still bright, make the proud hearts little
Firstborn back from the grave, no riddle
Harvest in His hands, whole earth that’s brittle
We lift up loaves, we lift our lives
Wave ‘em high where the True Flame drives
From the dirt to the heights, we arrive
In the Firstfruits King, we’re alive, we’re alive
(Chorus)
This that firstfruits gravity, bodies rise rapidly
Harps in the heavenlies, 808s mad at me
YahuShua stomped death, shattered that tragedy
Now we dance heavy in resurrected majesty
